_comment: Shared @match test table, read by BOTH the Swift matcher tests and the
JavaScript guard tests. Neither language owns it.
The Swift side decides which scripts to inject; the JS side re-checks on
SPA route changes. If those two ever disagree, a script runs on a page it
was never meant to see -- and that disagreement is invisible in any test
that only exercises one language. This file is the cross-check.
